responsibility: Implements deserialization of GIMPLE basic blocks from LTO streams. It reads streamed statement records, tuple headers, operands, locations, histograms, EH region attachments, and PHI nodes; reconstructs statements and block contents in the current function; rebinds SSA_NAME defining statements; restores call/internal-fn metadata; and performs the input-side fixups needed to turn serialized GIMPLE and CFG block records back into live middle-end IR.
